title: Construct composable token matrix and elevation presets
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: The current token set for color, radius, spacing and elevation has drifted after multiple ad-hoc fixes. This causes inconsistent shadows across cards, irregular radius combinations in dense tables, and duplicated semantic tokens (eg. surface-01 vs card-surface). Goal: Deliver a composable, ingredient-based token matrix that unifies color ramps, a 5-step radius scale, spacing cadence, and a deterministic elevation preset set (shadows + uplift) that maps to physical spacing and z-index usages. The deliverable includes token names, recommended usage guidelines, a migration mapping for components (buttons, tables, charts, cards), Figma styles, and a staged rollout plan with a compatibility layer for existing tokens.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Token matrix documented in Confluence with canonical names and rationale for each axis (hue, chroma, ramp, neutral ramp).
2) Elevation presets: 4 canonical elevations (surface, raised, overlay, modal) with exact shadow stacks and opacity steps.
3) All core components updated in Figma and a migration table mapping old tokens to new tokens.
4) Implementation guidance for engineering (CSS variables and JSON token export) and a migration PR created in the tokens repo.
5) Accessibility checks validated: contrast ratios meet AA for text on interactive surfaces and focus outlines preserved.
decisions:
- Adopt 4 semantic elevation presets (surface / card, raised / interactive, overlay / popover, modal / full-screen) instead of the previous 6-step physical ramp to reduce implementation complexity.
- Use rem-based spacing tokens with base 4px grid expressed as 0.25rem increments for consistency with existing CSS architecture.
- Radius scale standardized to 5 values: 0, 2, 6, 12, 24 (px) and exposed as token names radius-0..radius-4.
- Prefer semantic color tokens (bg-surface, bg-muted, accent-primary) backed by neutral and chromatic ramps rather than component-specific color names.
- Keep backward-compatibility aliases for 3 releases (aliases: card-surface -> bg-surface) and introduce a codemod to assist migration.
migration_plan:
Phase 1 (Week 1): Finalize token names and Figma styles. Phase 2 (Week 2): Export token JSON, open tokens repo PR with aliases and tests. Phase 3 (Week 3-4): Component spec updates (buttons, tables, charts) and small canary rollout in Console QA. Phase 4 (Week 5): Fleetwide migration, deprecate aliases after two releases.
Notes: Engineering will use a compatibility flag (feature flag 'new-tokens') to toggle usage during rollout.
qa_checklist:
- Visual regression snapshots for primary components (buttons, cards, table rows, chart tooltips).
- Contrast audit report for all semantic text/interactive combinations.
- Verify CSS variable fallbacks are present for older browsers.
- Run codemod in a sample repo and verify no regressions.
- Confirm Figma tokens match exported JSON (auto-sync pass).
